narrative.details:
The medallion contained Valthalak's soul?  It's no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.

Locating Bodley presents a bit of a problem.  Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire.  He was never heard of again.

Seek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now.  I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!

Will you help us, adventurer? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.

Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!

quests.objectiveText: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.

quests.name: Falrin's Vendetta
quests.objectiveText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

quests.name: The Instigator's Enchantment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.

quests.name: The Challenge
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.
